loans.title: Your loans
loans.notPaidNotice: Your membership is not marked as paid yet, so borrowing is off. Pay at the shop and an admin will switch it on.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Browsing needs no account. Sign in to borrow, using the address an admin has on the member list.
auth.checkTitle: The link is on its way
auth.checkBody: Open it on this device to finish signing in. It expires in 24 hours. If it has not arrived in a minute or two, look in spam.

errors.superAdminProtected: Super admins cannot be changed here.
errors.returnBooksFirst: Check their books back in before revoking access.
errors.missingShelfMark: Enter a shelf mark, for example PR-014.
errors.missingTitle: Enter a title in at least one language.
errors.pageCountInvalid: Page count must be a whole number, like 240.

errors.photosTooLarge: The photos add up to {size} MB, which is too large to send in one go. Remove one or two and press Save again.
errors.storageNotConfigured: Photo storage is not set up on the server, so the book was not saved. Remove the photos to save without them, and tell the site owner.
errors.photoUploadFailed: A photo could not be stored ({reason}). The book was not saved. Press Save again, or remove that photo.

errors.photosStillPreparing: Photos are still being prepared. Wait a moment, then press Save.
errors.connectionLost: Could not reach the server. Check the Wi-Fi or mobile signal, then press Save again. Your entries are still here.
errors.copiesInvalid: Number of copies must be a whole number from 1 to 999.
errors.alreadyHaveCopy: You already have a copy of this book.
